RDM Calculation¶

neurora.rdm_cal

Function Index¶

  • bhvRDM

  • eegRDM

  • eegRDM_bydecoding

  • fmriRDM

  • fmriRDM_roi

API Details¶

a module for calculating the RDM based on multimode neural data

neurora.rdm_cal.bhvRDM(bhv_data, sub_opt=1, method='correlation')¶

Calculate RDMs for behavioral data.

Parameters:

  • bhv_data (array_like, shape [n_cons, n_subs, n_trials]) – Behavioral data.

  • sub_opt ({0, 1}, default=1) –

    Whether to return subject-level RDMs or an averaged RDM.

    • 1: calculate one RDM for each subject.

    • 0: average trials and use subjects as features.

  • method ({"correlation", "amplitude"}, default="correlation") – Method used to calculate dissimilarities when sub_opt=0.

Returns:

rdms – Behavioral RDMs.

If sub_opt=1, shape is [n_subs, n_cons, n_cons]. If sub_opt=0, shape is [n_cons, n_cons].

Return type:

ndarray

neurora.rdm_cal.eegRDM(EEG_data, chl_opt=0, time_opt=0, time_win=5, time_step=5, method='correlation')¶

Calculate RDMs based on EEG-like data.

Parameters:

  • EEG_data (array_like, shape [n_cons, n_subs, n_trials, n_chls, n_ts]) – EEG/MEG/fNIRS/ECoG/sEEG-like data.

  • chl_opt ({0, 1}, default=0) –

    Whether to calculate RDMs separately for each channel.

    • 0: use all channels as features.

    • 1: calculate one RDM for each channel.

  • time_opt ({0, 1}, default=0) –

    Whether to calculate RDMs separately for each time window.

    • 0: use all time points as features.

    • 1: calculate one RDM for each time window.

  • time_win (int, default=5) – Time-window size in samples. Only used when time_opt=1.

  • time_step (int, default=5) – Step size between adjacent time windows. Only used when time_opt=1.

  • method ({"correlation", "amplitude"}, default="correlation") –

    Method used to calculate dissimilarities.

    • ”correlation”: 1 - Pearson correlation between condition patterns.

    • ”amplitude”: absolute difference between mean feature amplitudes.

Returns:

rdms – EEG-like RDMs.

If chl_opt=0 and time_opt=0: - shape [n_subs, n_cons, n_cons]

If chl_opt=0 and time_opt=1: - shape [n_subs, n_windows, n_cons, n_cons]

If chl_opt=1 and time_opt=0: - shape [n_subs, n_chls, n_cons, n_cons]

If chl_opt=1 and time_opt=1: - shape [n_subs, n_chls, n_windows, n_cons, n_cons]

Return type:

ndarray

neurora.rdm_cal.eegRDM_bydecoding(EEG_data, time_win=5, time_step=5, navg=5, time_opt='average', nfolds=5, nrepeats=2, normalization=False)¶

Calculate RDMs using classification-based neural decoding for EEG-like data.

Parameters:

  • EEG_data (array_like, shape [n_cons, n_subs, n_trials, n_chls, n_ts]) – EEG-like data.

  • time_win (int, default=5) – Time-window size in samples.

  • time_step (int, default=5) – Time-step size in samples.

  • navg (int, default=5) – Number of trials used to average.

  • time_opt ({"average", "features"}, default="average") – Whether to average time points or use time points as features.

  • nfolds (int, default=5) – Number of folds.

  • nrepeats (int, default=2) – Number of repeated iterations.

  • normalization (bool, default=False) – Whether to normalize data.

Returns:

rdms – Decoding-based EEG-like RDMs.

Return type:

ndarray, shape [n_subs, n_windows, n_cons, n_cons]

neurora.rdm_cal.fmriRDM(fmri_data, ksize=(3, 3, 3), strides=(1, 1, 1), method='correlation')¶

Calculate searchlight RDMs based on fMRI data.

Parameters:

  • fmri_data (array_like, shape [n_cons, n_subs, nx, ny, nz]) – fMRI data.

  • ksize (tuple or list of int, default=(3, 3, 3)) – Searchlight kernel size along x, y, and z axes.

  • strides (tuple or list of int, default=(1, 1, 1)) – Searchlight strides along x, y, and z axes.

  • method ({"correlation", "amplitude"}, default="correlation") –

    Method used to calculate dissimilarities.

    • ”correlation”: 1 - Pearson correlation between condition patterns.

    • ”amplitude”: absolute difference between mean voxel amplitudes.

Returns:

subrdms – fMRI searchlight RDMs.

Return type:

ndarray, shape [n_subs, n_x, n_y, n_z, n_cons, n_cons]

Notes

A searchlight unit is skipped for all subjects if any voxel in that searchlight contains NaN for any condition or subject.

neurora.rdm_cal.fmriRDM_roi(fmri_data, mask_data, method='correlation')¶

Calculate ROI RDMs based on fMRI data.

Parameters:

  • fmri_data (array_like, shape [n_cons, n_subs, nx, ny, nz]) – fMRI data.

  • mask_data (array_like, shape [nx, ny, nz]) – ROI mask. Non-zero and finite voxels are included.

  • method ({"correlation", "amplitude"}, default="correlation") –

    Method used to calculate dissimilarities.

    • ”correlation”: 1 - Pearson correlation between condition patterns.

    • ”amplitude”: absolute difference between mean voxel amplitudes.

Returns:

subrdms – fMRI ROI RDMs.

Return type:

ndarray, shape [n_subs, n_cons, n_cons]

Notes

A voxel is included only if it is non-zero in the mask, finite in the mask, and finite for all conditions and subjects in fmri_data.
